> 410 Gone means the resource existed and has been permanently removed, deliberately, with no forwarding address.

It differs from 404 Not Found, which only says the server could not find it and leaves open the possibility that it is a mistake or temporary. Search engines treat 410 as a stronger, more definite signal than 404, so it is the right code for content you intentionally deleted and never intend to restore. Use 301 instead if a replacement page exists.
